Over 27 ways in this site carry abandoned:attraction tags, all last edited 2021-05. Asking a mapper to check current aerial imagery against the tags: if the track and rides are gone from the imagery, these abandoned:attraction tags describe only history. Is there a preferred tag for a former attraction on cleared ground? Could not check imagery myself, so I am not editing.
